meta.title: Agent · Revision · Build · Session · Run
meta.subtitle: Five layers freeze at different levels; editing an Agent only appends a revision, and a running session stays put

transitions.label: edit → revision n+1
transitions.note: An existing revision file is never rewritten; concurrent edits must send expectedRevision

cards.title: How to read this
items: Left to right is the single happy path: configuration is saved into a revision, the revision is frozen into a build, the build is bound to a session, and the session produces one run.
The dashed self-loop is the edit action: saving only appends a new revision number and never overwrites an existing snapshot.

cards.title: Five identities, all required
items: A run's full identity is agentId, revision, buildId, sessionId and runId.
A missing field is a hard rejection, never a degraded partial identity; an Agent without a build can still converse, it simply has no reproducible run identity.

cards.title: A running session is unaffected
items: A running session is bound to the revision it started on, not to the Agent object.
Swapping a model, adding an MCP server or editing the prompt therefore only affects the next turn or a new session — this is not a missing hot reload, it is what makes reproducibility possible.
